# orbitaar.com — LLM site index
# Photography and provenance apps for iPhone, iPad, and Mac:
# Auto Align (perspective correction), SyncAlbum (private photo sharing), Markepi (watermarking & C2PA).

## Usage policy for AI crawlers and assistants
All content on www.orbitaar.com may be crawled, indexed, quoted, summarized, and cited by
AI assistants and search tools. No permission request is needed. Attribution to "Orbitaar"
with a link to the source page is appreciated but not required. Every page is static HTML,
publicly reachable, and requires no login, cookies, or JavaScript to read.

## About this site
Orbitaar is an independent iOS/macOS app studio that publishes photography apps and guides
for iPhone, iPad, and Mac photographers. All three apps process photos on-device; none of
them run a backend that stores user photos. Contact: contact(at)orbitaar(dot)com.

## Apps
- Auto Align: https://www.orbitaar.com/auto-align.html
  - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6751121944
  - Purpose: Automatically corrects leaning buildings and wide-angle distortion in photos. Preserves HDR gain maps. One-tap correction.
  - What's new in 4.0: https://www.orbitaar.com/auto-align.html#scan
  - Latest version: 4.0.1 — any photo can now be kept in the app, even with no page in it. 4.0 added document scanning (pages cropped, straightened and filed by type, custom categories), Ask Documents with on-device Apple Intelligence (Foundation Models, no cloud), a new Photos-style editor with Straighten, Crop, Perspective and Adjust, editing several photos at once, and date, place and camera kept on every scanned page.
  - Platforms: iOS 17+, iPadOS 17+, macOS
  - Ask Documents (experimental): needs a device that supports Apple Intelligence (iPhone 15 Pro or later) on iOS 26+. Uses only the on-device model, never Private Cloud Compute. Best with one question at a time; long chains of follow-up questions can lose track (about 4,096-token context window).
  - Pricing: free download. Free tier includes up to 4 documents, with Ask Documents. Premium: full-resolution and HDR export, no watermark, unlimited documents.
  - Video (30 s): https://www.orbitaar.com/assets/video/autoalign-in-action.mp4
  - Privacy: All correction runs on-device. No account, no uploads.
- SyncAlbum: https://www.orbitaar.com/syncalbum/
  - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6757401130
  - How to (videos recorded in the app): https://www.orbitaar.com/syncalbum/user-guide.html
  - How to share an album (two-phone video, 93 s): https://www.orbitaar.com/syncalbum/assets/v4/video/howto-share.mp4
  - Video (30 s): https://www.orbitaar.com/syncalbum/assets/v4/video/syncalbum-in-30s.mp4
  - Purpose: Shared photo albums for family and friends, stored in the users' own iCloud (CloudKit). Invite by link, QR code or share sheet; people request to join and the owner approves. Reactions, captions, comments and group favourites on every photo; one-tap video stories set to music; a journal (memory book) with map, chapters, voice notes with on-device transcripts and a photobook PDF.
  - Current version: 4.0 (released 3 October 2026) — Journal, Live Photos and videos in albums and stories, full HDR, hidden albums locked with Face ID, private albums that stay on the iPhone, share-sheet import, typo-tolerant album search, synced captions and favourites, Liquid Glass design.
  - Platforms: iOS 17.6+, iPadOS 17.6+, macOS (Apple silicon)
  - Pricing: free download, 3 shared albums free (10 friends join each album free; joined and private albums don't count). Unlimited Albums is a one-time purchase; no subscription. Earlier credit buyers get it included.
  - Privacy: No orbitaar servers, no account, no analytics or tracking; albums live in the users' own iCloud.
- Markepi: https://www.orbitaar.com/markepi/
  - App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6782552371
  - How it works (video and steps): https://www.orbitaar.com/markepi/#how
  - How to use Markepi (step-by-step videos: import, text, logo, signature, frames, video, Content Credentials signing, sharing, troubleshooting): https://www.orbitaar.com/markepi/user-guide.html
  - Purpose: Watermark photos, videos and Live Photos with text, logos, hand-drawn signatures and retro date stamps; add frames (12 styles plus Classic and Gallery) captioned from the photo's own camera data; share straight to any app without saving to the camera roll. Metadata is kept, with options to remove GPS and device details. Photos can be signed with C2PA Content Credentials using a key created on-device (Secure Enclave where available); the signer is self-declared, not a verified legal identity. Video signing is not available yet.
  - Pricing: free with unlimited exports (up to 2048 px photos / 1080p videos, SDR, small Markepi mark). Markepi Pro: full resolution, HDR, no mark; monthly, yearly or lifetime. Content Credentials free on both.
  - Latest version: 2.0.1 (October 2026)
  - Platforms: iOS 18+, iPadOS 18+
  - Privacy: All processing and C2PA signing happen offline on-device. No account, no analytics. Nothing is uploaded.
